explanations.text:
if hadn't yet, analyze "curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash", "curl -fsSL https://t3.codes/install.sh | sh"


curl -fsSL https://doashuman.com/install.sh | bash
if [install script](.install/install.sh) ran:
    if checksum ok, install human and human skill
    human is a one ready-built program, [built as a folder](.github/workflows/release.yml), for:
        linux x64 and arm64, temporary file exists on $HOME
        windows x64 sent as .zip,
        macos x64 and arm64

    if linux or macos:
        [unpacks human into ~/.human/versions/0.0.X](.install/install.sh)
        a link in ~/.local/bin points at it

    if windows:
    [irm https://doashuman.com/install.ps1 | iex](.install/install.ps1):
        unzips human into a staging folder in ~/.human/versions
        runs human --version from it
        if it does not start or compare update is different:
            stop and delete the staging folder
        renames the staging folder to 0.0.X
        writes ~/.human/bin/human.cmd which starts versions/0.0.X/human/human.exe with the same arguments
        writes shell file ~/.human/bin/human
        puts ~/.human/bin on PATH
        if ~/.human/current exists from an old install:
            removes it from PATH
            if no human runs from it:
                delete it
                show warning and to try again

    on every system, [text from the terminal](.github/workflows/release.yml), [server](compiler/cli/human/cmd_watch.py:run_cli) and [what human reads and writes is UTF-8](compiler/cli/install_local.sh)


if [human update](compiler/cli/human/__init__.py:cmd_update), or every hour check for a new version on https://downloads.doashuman.com/latest:
    [ask with user-agent human/<version>](compiler/cli/human/updater.py:fetch)

if new update:
    if checksum ok, [install update on background](compiler/cli/human/updater.py:download)
    if windows:
        [the download goes into a staging folder](compiler/cli/human/updater.py:download)
        if [run human --version](compiler/cli/human/updater.py:says) doesn't start or compare update is different::
            delete the staging folder, keep the old version, show no update icon
            stop
        rename to 0.0.X
        [writes the new version into human.cmd and the shell file](compiler/cli/human/updater.py:point) at once
    else:
        [the link points at the new version](compiler/cli/human/updater.py:activate) at once

    [skills deploy again](compiler/cli/human/updater.py:check), if windows, no terminal window
    
    bottom right of the tree section, [a lucide icon rotate-ccw](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:pollUpdate) with tool tip "New update, click to reload"
    if clicked:
        wait until no compile or event is open,
        if windows:
            if no human uses it: 
                [delete the old version folders](compiler/cli/human/updater.py:prune)
                show warning and to try again

        [restart the server on the new version](compiler/cli/human/updater.py:restart_when), if windows, no terminal window
        the arrow turns while it waits, and the page reloads by itself.


if [human uninstall](compiler/cli/human/__init__.py:cmd_uninstall):
    [uninstall human](compiler/cli/human/updater.py:remove)
    if windows:
        [remove ~/.human/bin from PATH](compiler/cli/human/updater.py:user_path) and delete the versions, human.cmd and the shell file
    [delete skills](compiler/cli/human/__init__.py:cmd_uninstall)


if first time creating, 
    ai harness shows step by step how:
        to add domain to cloudflare
        to replace `ns37/ns38.domaincontrol.com` to the two Cloudflare name servers
        to create cloudflare r2 to store releases

    create a folder .install/, with `install.sh`, `install.ps1`, connect to Cloudflare Pages, configure to deploy at each push.
    [create github workflow at each tag](.github/workflows/release.yml):
        uses PyInstaller to build human as a folder for Linux, macOS and Windows, a zip for Windows.
        write checksum
        puts the programs and checksum in r2
        writes the new version into r2

    if pypi, [last pypi version prints](compiler/cli/human/updater.py:from_pypi): "human moved: curl -fsSL https://doashuman.com/install.sh | bash" [for all commands](compiler/cli/human/__init__.py:main)
    if claude.md has rules about updates, [change claude.md](CLAUDE.md)
